parts.name: Switch (Left Handle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left switch handle of the faucet, made of stainless steel, used to control water flow or temperature.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to turn on/off or adjust the water flow, typically for hot or cold water control.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axis to open or close the internal valve mechanism.

parts.name: Switch (Right Handle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right switch handle of the faucet, made of stainless steel, used to control water flow or temperature.
parts.Functional_description: It functions similarly to the left handle, controlling either hot or cold water flow.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axis to regulate the internal valve for water control.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body or frame of the faucet, made of brass, which connects the spout and handles.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the internal water channels and valve mechanisms, providing structural support for the faucet.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the central support structure for the faucet assembly.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: This is the spout of the faucet, made of stainless steel, through which water flows out.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the water from the internal plumbing to the sink area, ensuring smooth flow.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel horizontally in some designs to direct water flow, but typically remains fixed.
